jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(H) inventory: North Bennington Graded School District, Inc., an incorporated graded district in the Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union (electorate: Village of North Bennington plus Shaftsbury District 1). Non-operating since 2013 (PK-6 tuition/choice). The Village School of North Bennington is an independent approved school with a self-perpetuating board -- NOT this district.

board.org_name: North Bennington Graded School District Prudential Committee

sources.note: North Bennington GSD is governed by a five-member Prudential Committee under its charter (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 15, section 15-2), elected at large by the district's voters (Village of North Bennington + Shaftsbury District 1) by Australian ballot, three-year terms with unexpired-term fills. Only one membership is minted (see the source note); the directory as last published (Feb. 2025) is: Mullineaux 2026, Patterson 2025, McNamara 2027, Kane 2025, Deponte-Disorda 2026. SVSU/North Bennington/MAU Annual Report 2024 (for the March 4, 2025 meeting), NBGSD Directory: Raymond Mullineaux (Chair) term expires 2026; Matthew Patterson (Vice Chair) 2025; Kiernan McNamara (Clerk) 2027; Tim Kane 2025; Lani Deponte-Disorda 2026. The district's charter (16 V.S.A. App. ch. 15, section 15-2): "The Prudential Committee shall consist of five persons," elected for three-year terms, vacancies filled at a warned meeting for the unexpired term only. The district has been non-operating since 2013 (tuitions PK-6 by school choice; Village of North Bennington education page). The March 4, 2025 and March 3, 2026 election results were NOT fetched -- the seats expiring 2025 (Patterson, Kane) and 2026 (Mullineaux, Deponte-Disorda) are therefore HELD, and only the member whose published term (2027) runs past the March 2026 election is minted (the standard applied to Mt. Anthony in batch 6). Resolving documents: the NBGSD 2025/2026 annual meeting minutes or the FY27 SVSU/NB/MAU report's NBGSD directory page.

directors.name: Kiernan McNamara
directors.note: Committee Clerk; term as published in the district's own directory (Feb. 2025).
